title: The Ring of Amethyst
author: Alice Wellington Rollins

authorInfo.bio: Alice Wellington Rollins (1847–1897) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Ring of Amethyst" by Alice Wellington Rollins is a collection of poems that captures the emotional landscape of love, longing, and introspection, written during the late 19th century. The work employs the metaphor of the amethyst both as a physical ring and as a symbol of deep affection and unique beauty.
